response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, g.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, above_overall AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q ORDER BY avg_mod DESC

assumptions.assumption: 'Average' means the overall mean modindex across all signals with a non-null modindex (each signal weighted equally), not the mean of the per-status averages.
Signals with NULL rfistat form their own group (GROUP BY keeps NULL as a group). Empty-string statuses are treated as ordinary values.
'How far above average' is the status average minus the overall average. The difference from the qualifying mean is the status average minus the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Average' is the unweighted mean of the per-status averages (every status counts equally, whatever its signal count).
